passes.name: AIM High Season Pass
passes.access: Unlimited at both Berkshire East and Catamount - the two mountains sell one joint pass rather than two. It also carries two days each at Burke Mountain and Smugglers' Notch with 50% off further days, unlimited midweek skiing at Burke through March, and 25% off non-holiday lodging at both. AIM stands for Authentic Independent Mountains, which is the marketing and also an accurate description of the arrangement.

passes.name: Indy Pass
passes.access: Two days per season on the Indy Pass. Berkshire East also sells the discounted Indy AddOn Pass to its own AIM High passholders, which gives two days at each of the 300-plus Indy partners but is explicitly not valid at Berkshire East itself.

passes.name: Fairbank Group three-mountain benefit
passes.access: Bromley, Cranmore in New Hampshire and Jiminy Peak in Massachusetts are all Fairbank Group mountains, and the group sells across them. A Jiminy Peak Anytime or Zephyr season pass carries two free lift tickets at Bromley, and a $471 three-mountain college pass gives unlimited access to all three. This does not make Bromley a multi-mountain-pass resort - its own site is emphatic that Ikon is not valid here - but it is the one route to Bromley days that does not go through Bromley's own ticket window.
